features.name: Simple Object
features.description: Maps one object with scalar values to a newly allocated destination object.

features.name: Nested Object
features.description: Maps an order with nested customer and address objects to a new destination graph.

features.name: Collection
features.description: Maps an array of 100 objects while preserving count, order and member values.

features.name: Flattening
features.description: Maps nested customer values into a flat order summary through member-path configuration.

features.name: Map To Existing
features.description: Overwrites a supplied destination object and returns that same instance.

features.name: Null Handling
features.description: Preserves null text, nested object and collection members in the destination.

features.name: Custom Conversion
features.description: Maps string values through registered code and invariant decimal conversions.

features.name: Polymorphic Mapping
features.description: Maps a base array containing cats and dogs to matching destination runtime types.

features.name: Prepare Configuration
features.description: Creates the complete mapper configuration and eagerly prepares its runtime mapping plans.

features.name: Prepare And Simple Map
features.description: Creates the complete mapper configuration and maps one simple object.
